title.narrative: Sustainable cities, integrated approach pilot in India

description.narrative: Sustainable Cities Integrated Approach Pilot in India, is one of the Child Projects under GEF's Sustainable Cities Programme in the GEF 6 cycle; Participating cities include Bhopal, Jaipur, Mysore, Vijayawada-Guntur. The aim of the project is to integrate sustainability strategies into urban planning and management to create a favorable environment for investment in infrastructure and service delivery, thus building the resilience of pilot cities.
